studio.name: Remedy Entertainment
studio.tagline: Crafting story-driven action games with unique atmosphere
studio.description: Remedy Entertainment is a Finnish video game developer based in Espoo, best known for creating Max Payne, Alan Wake, Control, and Quantum Break. Founded in 1995, Remedy has earned a reputation for cinematic storytelling, atmospheric world-building, and innovative gameplay mechanics. The studio pioneered the use of bullet time in gaming with Max Payne and has consistently pushed the boundaries of narrative-driven action games.
studio.publisherPartners: Epic Games Publishing, 505 Games, Rockstar Games, Microsoft
studio.knownFor: Max Payne, Alan Wake, Control, Alan Wake 2, Quantum Break

games.name: Alan Wake 2
games.description: Saga Anderson arrives to investigate ritualistic murders in a small town. Alan Wake writes a dark story to shape the reality around him. These two heroes are somehow connected. A survival horror game with gripping narrative and stunning visuals.

keyFeatures.description: Play as both FBI Agent Saga Anderson and writer Alan Wake in interweaving storylines.
Intense atmospheric horror with resource management and light-based combat.
Saga's detective investigation mechanic using a mental crime board.

games.name: Control
games.description: After a secretive agency in New York is invaded by an otherworldly threat, Jesse Faden becomes the new Director struggling to regain Control. Explore the brutalist labyrinth of the Oldest House, wield supernatural abilities, and uncover the Bureau's dark secrets.

keyFeatures.description: Wield supernatural abilities like telekinesis, levitation, and shield alongside the transforming Service Weapon.
Explore a brutalist skyscraper that constantly shifts and defies the laws of physics.
Crossover expansion connecting Control's universe with Alan Wake.

games.name: Quantum Break
games.description: When a time travel experiment goes wrong, Jack Joyce gains the ability to manipulate time. He must use these powers to prevent the end of time itself while battling Monarch Solutions. Features a unique blend of gameplay and live-action TV show episodes.

keyFeatures.description: Freeze, rewind, and manipulate time in both combat and puzzles.
Gameplay choices affect live-action TV show episodes between acts.
Features performances by Shawn Ashmore, Aidan Gillen, and Lance Reddick.

games.name: Alan Wake
games.description: Bestselling thriller novelist Alan Wake embarks on a desperate search for his missing wife in the small town of Bright Falls, only to discover pages from a thriller he doesn't remember writing that are coming true. A psychological action thriller told in the style of a TV series.

keyFeatures.description: Story unfolds across 6 TV-style episodes with recaps and cliffhangers.
Use flashlights, flares, and other light sources to weaken enemies before finishing them off.
Discover pages that foreshadow upcoming events and deepen the mystery.

games.name: Alan Wake Remastered
games.description: The classic psychological action thriller returns with updated 4K visuals, improved character models, and all previously released DLC included. Experience the award-winning story of Alan Wake in Bright Falls with modern fidelity.

games.name: Max Payne
games.description: A DEA agent and fugitive, Max Payne, wages a one-man war against the criminal underworld of New York City to avenge the death of his wife and baby daughter. The game that popularized bullet time in gaming, featuring a gritty noir narrative told through graphic novel panels.

keyFeatures.description: Revolutionary slow-motion mechanic that changed third-person shooters forever.
Dark, noir narrative delivered through hand-drawn comic panels.

games.name: Max Payne 2: The Fall of Max Payne
games.description: Max Payne 2 continues the story of renegade DEA agent Max Payne in a dark, twisted love story with Mona Sax. Features enhanced ragdoll physics, improved bullet time, and a deeply emotional noir narrative set against the backdrop of a cold New York winter.

keyFeatures.description: Improved slow-motion combat with Havok ragdoll physics.
A film-noir love story between Max Payne and the mysterious Mona Sax.

games.name: Control 2
games.description: The sequel to the award-winning Control, currently in active development at Remedy Entertainment. Expected to expand on the Oldest House and the Remedy Connected Universe.
